INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.

2. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

3. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

6. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.

   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables
